title: The Plan of St Gall
statement: The Carolingian Plan of St. Gall is the oldest surviving architectural drawing of the Western world, and thus it is a monument of European cultural history.
cite: Cod. Sang. 1092, Stiftsbibliothek St. Gallen, manuscript summary on e-codices.

image.alt: The Plan of St Gall, a parchment sheet covered in ink drawings of monastery buildings and Latin labels
image.credit: Image: e-codices, Virtual Manuscript Library of Switzerland, St. Gallen, Stiftsbibliothek, Cod. Sang. 1092.

question: The plan was drawn on separate pieces of sheep parchment sewn into one sheet. How many pieces?
